commitResults.messageTitle: Document known limitations as planned enhancements
commitResults.messageBody:
The DG said there were no planned enhancements, and the UG did not
list several limitations a tester can easily hit, such as s/o in
names, international phones or clearing an optional field.

List ten limitations, each checked against the current app, in the
DG's Planned Enhancements with the planned behaviour, and in the UG's
"Features not included in this release" as not supported in this
version.

Fixes #281

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Test: Cover hidden characters in the assess index
commitResults.messageBody:
Coverage showed that the error path for an index containing a hidden
or control character was never exercised by the assess parser tests.
The code already rejects such an index as invalid, but nothing pinned
that behaviour, so a later change could break it unnoticed.

Add one test that checks a zero-width space and control characters
before and after the digit are all reported as an invalid index. Only
test code changes; nothing under src/main is touched.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Test: Cover hidden characters in the assess index
